$comment: Work items for coding agents (see docs/agents/README.md). Statuses: not-started | in-progress | blocked | done. A done item needs evidence; an in-progress item needs its branch (name without any account/user prefix), and a branch owns at most one in-progress item. Items stay in id order: insert a new item at its sorted position, edit only your own item, and on a rebase conflict keep both items with unique ids. No item authorizes a commit, push, version bump, release or publication. Contract: test/agent-harness-*.test.ts.

features.name: Agent harness: routing pages, state files, startup check
features.description: Five-subsystem harness (learn-harness-engineering harness-creator): CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as short routing pages (12 KiB budget) keeping every mandatory rule, reference material moved verbatim to docs/agents/ and docs/testing.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, session-handoff.md, init.sh, the harness files in the sandbox test image, and the contract tests test/agent-harness-instructions.test.ts and test/agent-harness-state.test.ts.
features.evidence: 2026-11-12, base da289219; lands in the commit that adds this entry. bun run test:sandbox green on the exact staged tree: unit 11668 pass / 0 fail / 398 skip, tcp 553 / 0, embedded 349 / 0, no resource anomalies (artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-12T20-20-16.500Z/summary.md); the 22 contract tests pass inside the unit container. Host: bun test test/agent-harness 22 / 0, ./init.sh green, bun run typecheck and bun run format:check clean, git diff --check clean, generate-release-posts.ts --check OK; course validate-harness.mjs structural score 32/100 before, 100/100 after. bun run test:model and bun run test:sandbox:sdk not triggered (no src/ or sdk/ change). Skeptic: FAIL, then fixes, then PASS on the final delta.

features.name: Agent harness: non-blocking review notes
features.description: Minor notes from the agent-harness skeptic review: init.sh compares pwd -P with git rev-parse --show-toplevel, so a differently-cased path on case-insensitive APFS skips the git checks with only a notice (check that git rev-parse --show-prefix is empty instead); CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are within ~200 bytes of the 12 KiB budget; the contract's Dockerfile.test COPY parser reads single-line COPY only (fails closed); the inline-code stripper in the link check can mis-pair double-backtick spans; a done item is only checked for non-empty evidence; branch names without the account prefix can collide across users in the one-item-per-branch check.

features.name: Reload the TLS certificate on SIGHUP without a restart
features.description: Issue 189: a renewed certificate on disk was only served after a restart, and SIGHUP killed the process. With TLS configured, SIGHUP re-reads TLS_CERT_FILE/TLS_KEY_FILE, validates the pair and moves the TCP and HTTP listeners to it all-or-nothing, keeping open connections on their certificate and rolling back on failure.
features.evidence: Commit da289219 on main. Tests: test/repro-issue-189-tls-reload.test.ts, test/repro-issue-189-tls-reload-outcomes.test.ts, test/repro-issue-189-tls-reload-process.test.ts. bun run test:sandbox green: unit 11646 pass / 0 fail (398 skip), tcp 553 / 0, embedded 349 / 0, artifacts artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-12T19-22-12.368Z/. Skeptic PASS before the commit and before the push.

features.name: Unix-socket rollback follow-ups from the issue 189 review
features.description: Two non-blocking skeptic notes on src/infrastructure/server/httpListener.ts: (1) on the rollback rebind of the HTTP unix socket, a chown failure other than EPERM throws before chmodSync runs, so the previous mode is not restored either; (2) the two new warning paths (owner/group not restored, rollback permissions not restored) have no test. Write the reproducing tests first, then fix.

features.name: Release bunqueue 2.9.22
features.description: Release checklist (docs/agents/release.md), every step only on the user's explicit request: set the package.json version to 2.9.22 and run bun run docs:api; date the 2.9.22 changelog section; align the Docker image references in README.md and the deployment, env-vars, installation and server guides as commit 2d617fd3 did for 2.9.21; generate and hand-write the release post per the release-post rules; gates: bun run test:sandbox, bun run test:sandbox:sdk (sdk/ changed since v2.9.21), fresh Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13 OrbStack Machines per docs/testing.md, skeptic PASS; push to main with explicit authorization (CI's version gate tags, releases and publishes); after publication run bun docs/scripts/generate-release-posts.ts --refresh and update the post.
